authorizationBasis.projectDirective: Complete the full MouldMaster Book evidence, qualification, runtime-parity and publication-governance pass.

runtimeIntegrity.scope: Exact served bytes for every payload that can influence Book publication promotion, reader composition, editorial expansion review or independent-SME status. Git object identity is checked in-browser before JSON parsing; any mismatch fails closed.

publicationBoundaries: Source evidence reviewed means the generic governed Book wording passed the MouldMaster evidence and publication gates; it does not imply independent human SME approval and does not make generic guidance a machine, material, mould, hot-runner, product or site-specific instruction.
The 21 qualified claims retain their applicability, exclusions and non-universal scope exactly as reviewed.
Grade-specific processing values require current grade-specific manufacturer evidence and are not created by this authorization.
Machine, controller, mould, hot-runner and site safety procedures remain controlled by the applicable manufacturer and workplace documentation.
Troubleshooting remains hypothesis-and-evidence based; verification does not convert diagnostic possibilities into guaranteed causes or fixes.
Peer-reviewed learner-facing links use canonical DOI/publisher records where available; discovery indexes are not treated as the controlling citation target.

Worked engineering examples are synthetic teaching data with explicit assumptions and evidence anchors; they are not measured production evidence, universal settings, independent SME approval or machine-control authority.

Evidence-enrichment sections are exact-byte authorized generic teaching content recovered from the previously validated editorial stack; source-specific values retain source context, synthetic examples remain labelled, and independent human SME review remains a separate HOLD.

The Material Data Atlas is an exact-byte authorized technical-review appendix. It consumes all 260 validated canonical exact-grade records plus every one of the 284 governed Asia/Australia/New Zealand evidence rows; the 89-profile regional index is reconciliation-only. Catalogue and regional values retain manufacturer, grade, source, test-condition, lifecycle, process and value-status context; they are not independently SME-approved, universal settings, guaranteed specifications or production recipes. The technical-review appendix is excluded from the source-evidence-reviewed listen-all path.

Eighteen instructional SVG diagrams are generic mechanism explanations with governed asset hashes and explicit non-scale boundaries; they are not CFD/FEA outputs, mould designs, machine-specific setup drawings, safety drawings or independent SME approval.
Any later hold, conflicting evidence, stale controlling source, read/listen divergence, byte-integrity mismatch or claim-ledger regression must fail closed and block/revoke publication in release QA.

The 20 reader-facing chapters are structural groupings of the 46 governed modules. Reader grouping adds no technical claim and cannot change a module's claim, publication, SME, accreditation or production status.

The 2026-10-06 editorial expansion across 37 governed modules is bound to each module's existing governed claim IDs by data/book-editorial-expansion-review-v1.json; the completed depth pass adds mechanism, measurement, discriminating-evidence and falsification guidance without adding universal setpoints, machine-control authority or independent human SME approval.

Reader-level depth bands, learning objectives, knowledge checks and application prompts are derived teaching scaffolds only; they cannot add claims, upgrade evidence status or create production authority.

Packaging certification marks are interpreted only at their supported management-system scope: an ISO 9001/SAI Global marking does not certify resin properties, exact grade identity, processing conditions, lot acceptance or product conformity; current certificate validity and scope require separate verification.

The 2026-10-06.3 100-pass editorial revision varies repetitive diagnostic/falsification phrasing without changing governed claim meaning, clarifies that depth bands describe chapter complexity rather than strict learner progression, adds one synthetic complex-diagnostics capstone and three conceptual non-scale diagrams, and keeps all independent-human-SME status on HOLD.

workedCasesAuthorization.scope: Twenty-five synthetic worked engineering teaching cases with explicit assumptions, measurements/reasoning, uncertainty boundaries, evidence anchors and non-universal applicability boundaries, including a complex-diagnostics capstone.
workedCasesAuthorization.authorityBoundary: advisory-only; no validated recipe or automatic machine-control authority

evidenceEnrichmentAuthorization.scope: Evidence-backed Book enrichment across 10 existing chapters, including maintenance/recovery, hot-runner observability, cooling diagnosis, contamination reasoning, pressure loss, process-window robustness, warpage discrimination, process monitoring, ISO 9001:2026 quality-record discipline and certification-mark interpretation.
evidenceEnrichmentAuthorization.authorityBoundary: advisory-only; no universal setpoints, validated recipe authority or automatic machine control

materialAtlasAuthorization.scope: Complete Book material reference coverage: all validated canonical public exact-grade records plus every governed Asia/Australia/New Zealand source-wave row, preserving source status and boundaries.
materialAtlasAuthorization.authorityBoundary: technical-review appendix only; excluded from source-reviewed listen-all; no universal setpoints, guaranteed specifications, validated production recipe or automatic machine-control authority

learnerFacingPublicationMeaning: The governed module wording has passed MouldMaster claim/source and publication controls. The Book groups 46 governed modules into 20 reader chapters for readability; grouping does not change evidence status. This label is not independent human SME approval, accreditation, production validation or machine-control authority.

diagramAuthorization.scope: Twenty-one generic explanatory SVG diagrams bound to governed Book modules; each asset hash is recorded in the governed diagram ledger.
diagramAuthorization.authorityBoundary: instructional only; not scale drawings, simulation results, mould designs, safety drawings, production limits or machine-control authority

readerArchitectureAuthorization.authorityBoundary: Reader chapters are editorial groupings with derived depth labels, objectives, knowledge checks, application prompts and selected sequence prompts for continuity. These scaffolds add no technical claims; underlying governed module state, claims, evidence and SME status remain authoritative.

editorialExpansionAuthorization.authorityBoundary: Expanded prose across 37 governed modules is authorized only within each module's mapped existing governed claim scope; no independent human SME approval, universal recipe or production authority is implied.
